semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides environmental solutions specifically tailored for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: DAS Environmental Expert GmbH offers sustainable environmental solutions for waste gas abatement and wastewater treatment in the semiconductor industry. Their technologies help semiconductor manufacturers reduce emissions and effluents, ensuring compliance with international environmental standards while enhancing operational efficiency.

regional_presence.Europe: Headquartered in Dresden, Germany, with a focus on developing and providing environmental solutions.
